newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks open higher after Wall St rally.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks open higher after Wall St rally.

text.p: Tokyo stocks rose in early morning trade on Thursday, as the market received a psychological boost from Wall Street's gains overnight, brokers said.
But the key Nikkei index's upside could be limited because profit-taking interest remained strong ahead of corporate book closings at the end of March, they said.
At 0007 GMT, the 225-share Nikkei average climbed 144.64 points or 0.79 percent to 18,418.15. Its March futures gained 90 points to 18,390.
